passages.provision_quote: A school shall notify in writing at least one (1) parent of a student, if the student is an unemancipated minor, of a request made by the student to change the student's: (1) name; or (2) pronoun, title, or word to identify the student.
passages.note: Enrolled act text creates a mandatory, exception-free parent-notification duty for any name or pronoun change request.
Senate roll call shows Raatz voting Yea on final passage of the single-subject bill, well above the near-unanimous threshold.
passages.tally_quote: Yea 37 Education matters. Nay 12 Excused 1 Not Voting 0

passages.note: Bill details page names Raatz as a Senate sponsor of the bill whose digest describes the parental-notification requirement.
passages.actor_quote: Sponsored by: Sen. Stacey Donato, Sen. Jeff Raatz, Sen. Gary Byrne.

rows.reasoning: Raatz was a Senate sponsor of HB 1608 (2023) and voted Yea on its final passage; the enacted law requires a school to notify a parent in writing of any student request to change name, pronoun, title, or word to identify the student, with no exception, matching the rung requiring staff to notify parents whenever a student asks to be treated as a different gender at school.
